evidence.excerpt: columns: 前連結会計年度(受注高), 当連結会計年度(受注高), 増減率(%); 前連結会計年度(売上収益), 当連結会計年度(売上収益), 増減率(%); 前連結会計年度(セグメント損益), 当連結会計年度(セグメント損益), 増減率(%); row: 精密・電子; values: 301,551, 217,791, △27.8; 222,259, 246,998, 11.1; 36,183, 38,285, 5.8

notes: Ebara's Precision & Electronics (精密・電子) segment revenue, FY2023 (calendar year, 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31), current-year column of the 'セグメントごとの経営成績' (segment performance) table in the issuer's own annual securities report (有価証券報告書). This segment bundles vacuum pumps (真空ポンプ), CMP equipment (CMP装置), plating equipment (めっき装置) and exhaust-gas treatment equipment (排ガス処理装置) -- see the ebara_precision_electronics_segment reporting-scope definition and the entity note. Ebara states explicitly elsewhere in this same filing that it discloses no product-level split finer than this segment total ('製品及びサービスの区分が報告セグメントと同一であるため、記載を省略しています。'), so no part of this figure may ever be allocated to the cmp or plating category alone. The FY2023 annual securities report states explicitly, on this same page, that from Q1 of the fiscal year reportable segments were changed (the three-segment structure Fluid Machinery/Environmental Plant/Precision & Electronics reorganised into five: Buildings & Industry, Energy, Infrastructure, Environment and Precision & Electronics, effective January 2023) and that the prior year's figures are reclassified onto the new segmentation for comparison ('第１四半期連結累計期間より報告セグメントを変更しています。... 前年同期の数値を変更後のセグメント区分に組み替えて比較しています。'). This reorganisation split the old Fluid Machinery segment into Buildings & Industry/Energy/Infrastructure; Precision & Electronics itself was NOT redefined -- confirmed by cross-foot: the FY2022 Precision & Electronics figures restated here (orders 301,551 / revenue 222,259 / profit 36,183) are identical, to the yen, to the as-originally-reported FY2022 figures in the FY2022 annual securities report's own current-year column (ebara_fy2022_yuho_jp, physical p.30). So this packet's five-year Precision & Electronics series (FY2021-FY2025) needs no restatement flag: the segment's own composition is unchanged across the reorganisation, only its sibling segment was split.
